steps.title: Welcome to the workspace
steps.description: The overview is your starting point. From here, the navigation on the left takes you to surveys, workspaces and administration.

steps.title: Use the navigation
steps.description: The sidebar on the left shows all areas you have access to. Click an entry to switch to it.

steps.title: Next step
steps.description: Usually you start with “Surveys” to create a template, or with “Workspaces” to manage a workspace.

steps.title: What is the catalogue?
steps.description: Here you see all surveys of the organization. Surveys are reusable and do not belong to a single workspace.

steps.title: Create a new survey
steps.description: Click “New survey” at the top right to create a first draft.

steps.title: Understand the status
steps.description: Surveys can be Draft, Published or Archived. Only published versions can be assigned to workspaces.

steps.title: Show the archive
steps.description: The “Show archive” button shows or hides archived surveys.

steps.title: Set the basics
steps.description: Give the new survey a title and, optionally, a description.

steps.title: A draft is created
steps.description: After saving, an editable draft is created that you can fill with sections and questions.

steps.title: Continue in the editor
steps.description: You are then taken to the draft editor to add questions, options and validation rules.

steps.title: Sections and questions
steps.description: Structure the survey into sections and add typed questions (text, choice, scale, etc.).

steps.title: Answer options & validation
steps.description: For choice questions you define the answer options. You can also set validation rules such as required fields.

steps.title: Adjust the order
steps.description: The order of sections and questions determines how participants see the survey later.

steps.title: Publish
steps.description: Once the draft is ready, publish it. Published versions are immutable and can be assigned to workspaces.

steps.title: Immutable version
steps.description: This view shows a published, fixed version of the survey. Its content can no longer be changed here.

steps.title: Assign to workspaces
steps.description: Assign this version to one or more workspaces so campaigns there can be built on it.

steps.title: Drafts & versions
steps.description: Here you see all drafts and published versions of this survey and their status.

steps.title: Create a new draft
steps.description: You can derive a new draft from this survey or an existing version at any time (deep copy).

steps.title: Archive
steps.description: Surveys you no longer need can be archived and restored if necessary.

steps.title: Workspace management
steps.description: This list shows all workspaces you have access to, each as a separate tenant.

steps.title: Create a new workspace
steps.description: Use “New workspace” to create a workspace with its master data.

steps.title: Open a workspace
steps.description: Click a workspace to manage its campaigns, recipients and analytics.

steps.title: Enter master data
steps.description: Enter the name, address and other basic details of the workspace.

steps.title: Responsibility
steps.description: After creating it, you can assign platform users to this workspace so they can work there.

steps.title: Update master data
steps.description: Adjust the name, address and other details of the workspace.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.description: Save your changes so they become visible throughout the application.

steps.title: Choose a survey version
steps.description: Choose a published survey version that has already been assigned to this workspace. Campaigns are bound to exactly that version.

steps.title: Set the branding
steps.description: Adjust the campaign's appearance, e.g. the title and welcome text for participants.

steps.title: Select recipients
steps.description: Select the active recipients who should receive the campaign by email.

steps.title: Public link
steps.description: On creation, a non-guessable public link is also generated through which people can participate anonymously.

steps.title: Track the status
steps.description: Here you see the campaign's current status and its public participation link.

steps.title: Recipients & sending
steps.description: Check which recipients the campaign was sent to and what the delivery status is.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.description: Once responses exist, you will find them in the workspace's analytics view.

steps.title: Campaign overview
steps.description: All survey campaigns of this workspace are listed here with their status and period.

steps.title: Start a new campaign
steps.description: Use “Create campaign” to bind an assigned, published survey version to recipients of this workspace.

steps.title: Maintain the recipient list
steps.description: Manage this workspace's email recipients that can be selected for campaigns.

steps.title: Mind the status
steps.description: Only active recipients are available when creating a campaign.

steps.title: Analyze responses
steps.description: This view summarizes the responses received for this workspace's campaigns.

steps.title: Use the export
steps.description: You can export results as PDF or Excel to process them further.

steps.title: Central hub
steps.description: From here you reach this workspace's campaigns, recipients and analytics.

steps.title: Assigned surveys
steps.description: Check which published survey versions are currently assigned to this workspace.

steps.title: Manage platform users
steps.description: A valid Keycloak login alone does not grant access. Users must be approved here and assigned roles.

steps.title: Roles & workspace assignment
steps.description: Assign roles to users and decide which workspaces they may manage.

steps.title: SMTP configuration
steps.description: Here you configure email delivery for campaign invitations.

steps.title: Test email
steps.description: Send a test email to verify the connection before you send a campaign.

steps.title: Contextual help
steps.description: There is no specific guide for this area yet. Use the navigation on the left to switch to surveys, workspaces or administration.
